hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache

# Output the summary to the user
print("Here are the hotel options with gym and free wifi near Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum:")
for hotel in nearest_attractions.search_results:

hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

nearest_hotels = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, attractions=attractions, groupBy="hotel")

save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)
